summary_1line: Ravana sends seven ministers’ sons with an army to attack Hanuman, who nimbly evades their storm of arrows at the city gate.

image_candidates.scene_text: Seven armored princes in golden chariots thunder out of Lanka’s palace gates, their bows flashing like lightning as they charge toward Hanuman.
Hanuman stands at the gate of Lanka as a dense rain of arrows from the chariots darkens the sky and conceals his body.
Leaping through the air, Hanuman twists between volleys of arrows and racing chariots like a storm-god playing among lightning.
